note: Kneehill County campground along the west side of the Swalwell Dam reservoir (Fyten's Reservoir), southwest of the hamlet of Swalwell: the stalls sit between the campground road and Range Road 244A, with a grassy day-use strip and a reed fringe between the road and the water. Power boats are not allowed. No dump station on site (the nearest are in Torrington and Three Hills); potable water was unavailable for the 2026 season and the tap water had to be boiled. --Claude
